summary: Narrow university service lane between lab buildings; no room to pull out of the lane.
reasons: Lane hemmed by buildings and trees

drivers.seclusion: Non-residential university buildings 2-13 m away; dormitory 27 m off at the start. Busy campus, so not secluded.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane about one van wide with tree beds and building walls either side; no verge or pull-off visible.
drivers.traffic: Campus through lane with bollards mapped nearby; pedestrian crossing at the start.
drivers.convention: No sign of overnight stays; a few cars parked mid-section.

flags: Bollards and gates mapped nearby, none on the only access
Slope max 7.2% near the north end; about 0.5% at the best section
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy and tall buildings shade the lane for most of the day.

best_section.where: Cooper Road lane between the labs, where a few cars sit at the kerb
